title: Healthy Body, Happy Days
summary: Practise words for body parts, describe health problems and give simple advice in English.
keyIdeas: Use 'I have got a...' with health problems such as 'headache', 'stomach ache' and 'cold'.
Use 'My knee hurts' or 'My arm hurts' to say that a body part is painful.
Ask 'What is the matter?' to find out what is wrong.

activities.prompt: Match each body part with its description.
activities.explanation: Ears help us hear, eyes help us see, the stomach receives food and the knee is part of the leg.

pairs.right: You listen to sounds with this.
You look at things with this.
It is in the middle of your leg.

activities.prompt: A thermometer shows that Aisha has a temperature of 38 °C. What is the matter?
activities.explanation: A body temperature of 38 °C or more is a fever. Aisha should tell an adult.
activities.hint: Which word describes a high body temperature?
options: She has got a broken arm.

activities.prompt: 'I have got a cough' means 'Tengo tos' in Spanish.
activities.explanation: True. 'A cough' is the English expression for the Spanish word 'tos'.

activities.prompt: Choose the correct health problem to complete the sentence.
activities.explanation: 'My stomach hurts' describes a stomach ache.
activities.hint: Which body part receives the food you eat?
activities.sentence: Hugo says, 'My stomach hurts'. He has got a ___.

activities.prompt: Sort the words into Body Parts and Health Problems.
activities.explanation: The shoulder, ankle and elbow are body parts. A sore throat, headache and toothache are health problems or symptoms.

activities.prompt: Doctor: 'Hello, Mateo. What is the matter?' Mateo: '___'
activities.explanation: Answer 'What is the matter?' by describing the health problem, such as a sore throat.
activities.hint: The doctor is asking about a symptom or health problem.
options: I have got a sore throat.

activities.prompt: Read the story and answer the questions.
activities.explanation: The story describes Lucas visiting the school nurse when he feels unwell.
activities.title: A Visit to Nurse Clara
activities.text: Today at school, Lucas is not feeling well during PE class. He is sitting on the bench. Nurse Clara comes to talk to him. 'What is the matter, Lucas?' she asks. Lucas touches his head and says, 'I have got a bad headache and my throat hurts.' Nurse Clara checks his temperature. Lucas does not have a fever, but he looks very tired. 'You need to drink fresh water and rest quietly in this chair,' says Nurse Clara. After thirty minutes, Lucas feels much better.

questions.explanation: Lucas says that he has a bad headache and that his throat hurts.

questions.prompt: What does Nurse Clara tell Lucas to do?
questions.explanation: In the story, Nurse Clara tells Lucas to drink water and rest quietly in the chair.
options: Run three laps around the gym.
Drink fresh water and rest quietly.

activities.prompt: Complete the sentence with the correct action word.
activities.explanation: 'Hurts' means that a body part is painful.
activities.hint: Choose the word that describes pain.
activities.sentence: Martina tripped in the playground and her left knee ___.

activities.prompt: In this school, a teacher takes a sick pupil to the nurse. Put this example in order.
activities.explanation: In this example, the pupil tells the teacher and receives adult help. Not every school has a nurse.
items: You tell your teacher that you feel sick.
Your teacher takes you to the school nurse’s room.
The nurse asks what is wrong and checks you.

activities.prompt: Omar has got a terrible toothache after lunch. What is the best advice for him?
activities.explanation: Omar should tell an adult so they can help him receive dental care.
activities.hint: Which health professional looks after our teeth?
options: He should tell an adult and get help from a dentist.
